description: This file defines the Language controller class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles the retrieval and display of language options for different locales, managing the language selection process, and rendering the language chooser interface.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing language selection and display in the OpenCart catalog frontend.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads available languages, manages the current language setting, constructs the language switcher links, and renders the language selection view.
